We follow the standard evaluation protocol in the filtered setting ... we compute two ranking-based metrics: (1) mean reciprocal rank (MRR), which measures the mean of inverse ranks assigned to correct entities, and (2) hits at K (H@K, K ∈ {1, 3, 10}), which measures the proportion of correct triples among the top K predicted triples.
